newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman cuts ECI estimate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman cuts ECI estimate.

text.p: Lehman Brothers has lowered its earning estimate for ECI Telecom Ltd but maintained its 1-Buy recommendation for the Israeli company.
The investment house estimated ECI would earn $0.38 per share in the fourth quarter of 1996, revising its earlier assessment of $0.40 per share.
It also lowered its profit estimate for the company for all of 1996 to $1.35 from $1.38.

"We have shaved our fourth quarter EPS (earnings per share) estimate...mostly reflecting a more conservative gross margin assumption and the likelihood that interest income will be lower," Lehman said in a report.
Lehman said ECI's third-quarter results reflect strong growth in three of its four major product areas, with its U.S. unit Telematics continuing to lag behind.
The company's sales in the third quarter climbed to $151.2 million compared with Lehman's $145 million estimate.
"We continue to rate the stock 1-Buy based on its attractive valuation relative to its peers and the potential turnaround that we see unfolding at Telematics," the report said.
ECI's EPS in the third quarter totalled $0.34 per share, up from $0.31 in the year-earlier period.
